integrity: Analytic proof with complete moment bounds, independently computed finite consistency checks; scholarly priority not independently certified.
limitations: Stationary one-dimensional complete Poisson resetting, centered Gaussian scaled Brownian excursions, 0<beta<2, fixed rate and diffusivity; long-lag only. No incomplete-reset or heavy-tail claims. The 2025 general two-time position law may subsume the exact covariance through integration; the explicit three-regime asymptotic and coefficients are the evaluated finding.
title: An age-memory crossover in the stationary modulus covariance of reset scaled Brownian motion
